package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_encryption_at_rest_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-3 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}

steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.

tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

threat_model.attack_vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_firewall_whitelist_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-4 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_firewall"
  not r.change.after.firewall_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce firewall_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Audit Logs"]
      requirement["Civo Audit Logs: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0520"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo Audit Logs", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_least_privilege_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-5 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_automated_backups_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-6 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_pod_security_restricted_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-7 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce applications for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: API event collection
developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_audit_telemetry_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM (Tier-8 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_network"
  not r.change.after.audit_logging
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce audit_logging for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}

threat_model.attack_vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_tls_enforcement_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-9 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_loadbalancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce tls_enabled for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB

      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Audit Logs"]
      requirement["Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0525"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo Audit Logs", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }

      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_private_networking_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-10 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce network_id for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_encryption_at_rest_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-11 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_firewall_whitelist_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-12 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_firewall"
  not r.change.after.firewall_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce firewall_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: API event collection
developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-1 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_automated_backups_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-2 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Audit Logs"]
      requirement["Civo Audit Logs: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0530"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo Audit Logs", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_pod_security_restricted_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-3 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce applications for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.

failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_audit_telemetry_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM (Tier-4 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_network"
  not r.change.after.audit_logging
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce audit_logging for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_tls_enforcement_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-5 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_loadbalancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce tls_enabled for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_private_networking_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-6 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id

threat_model.attack_vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_encryption_at_rest_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-7 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}

      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0535"]
      requirement --> check

      check -->|Yes| review

    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo Audit Logs", h: 64, pos: "b" }

    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]

      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_firewall_whitelist_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-8 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_firewall"
  not r.change.after.firewall_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce firewall_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_least_privilege_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-9 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.

failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_automated_backups_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-10 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_pod_security_restricted_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-11 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications

}

threat_model.attack_vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_audit_telemetry_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM (Tier-12 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_network"
  not r.change.after.audit_logging
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce audit_logging for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Audit Logs"]
      requirement["Civo Audit Logs: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0540"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo Audit Logs", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_tls_enforcement_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-1 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_loadbalancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce tls_enabled for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_private_networking_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-2 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce network_id for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_encryption_at_rest_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-3 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_firewall_whitelist_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-4 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_firewall"
  not r.change.after.firewall_id

}

tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

threat_model.attack_vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_least_privilege_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-5 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Audit Logs"]
      requirement["Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0545"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo Audit Logs", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_automated_backups_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-6 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_pod_security_restricted_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-7 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce applications for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_audit_telemetry_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM (Tier-8 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_network"
  not r.change.after.audit_logging
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce audit_logging for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_private_networking_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-10 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce network_id for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Audit Logs"]
      requirement["Civo Audit Logs: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0550"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo Audit Logs", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_encryption_at_rest_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-11 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

A destination and delivery permissions

tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.

failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_firewall_whitelist_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-12 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_firewall"
  not r.change.after.firewall_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce firewall_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_least_privilege_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-1 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: API event collection
developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

aws configure list

checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-2 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

threat_model.attack_vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile)

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_pod_security_restricted_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-3 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce applications for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Audit Logs"]
      requirement["Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile)"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0555"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo Audit Logs", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_audit_telemetry_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM (Tier-4 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_network"
  not r.change.after.audit_logging
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce audit_logging for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_tls_enforcement_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-5 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_loadbalancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce tls_enabled for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.
Configure destination permissions and retention.
Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_private_networking_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-6 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce network_id for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo audit list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package civo.civo_audit.civo_audit_encryption_at_rest_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Audit Logs: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-7 Audit Logging & Action History)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Audit Logs configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}

developer_guide.contract: Event type, resource identity, event time, destination and retention
dependencies: Supported event sources with required categories enabled
A destination and delivery permissions
steps: Enable the required management or data event categories.

Generate a known API event and correlate it with a recorded request.
tests: Verify the known event arrives within the expected delivery window.
Test destination permission failure and delivery monitoring.
failures: Missing event: inspect category selection, exclusions and delivery permissions.
Unexpected delay: compare event time, ingestion time and service delivery behavior.

threat_model.attack_vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Marketplace configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_marketplace.civo_marketplace_tls_enforcement_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Marketplace: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-1 Kubernetes Marketplace Apps)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Marketplace configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_loadbalancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce tls_enabled for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo marketplace list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Marketplace"]
      requirement["Civo Marketplace: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0560"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-marketplace", label: "Civo Marketplace", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_marketplace.civo_marketplace_private_networking_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Marketplace: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-2 Kubernetes Marketplace Apps)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Marketplace configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce network_id for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo marketplace list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_marketplace.civo_marketplace_encryption_at_rest_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Marketplace: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-3 Kubernetes Marketplace Apps)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Marketplace configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo marketplace list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

# Rule: Civo Marketplace: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-4 Kubernetes Marketplace Apps)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Marketplace configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_firewall"
  not r.change.after.firewall_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce firewall_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo marketplace list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Marketplace configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_marketplace.civo_marketplace_least_privilege_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Marketplace: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-5 Kubernetes Marketplace Apps)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Marketplace configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo marketplace list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Marketplace"]
      requirement["Civo Marketplace: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0564"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-marketplace", label: "Civo Marketplace", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_marketplace.civo_marketplace_automated_backups_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Marketplace: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-6 Kubernetes Marketplace Apps)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Marketplace configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo marketplace list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_marketplace.civo_marketplace_pod_security_restricted_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Marketplace: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-7 Kubernetes Marketplace Apps)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Marketplace configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce applications for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo marketplace list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_marketplace.civo_marketplace_audit_telemetry_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Marketplace: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM (Tier-8 Kubernetes Marketplace Apps)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Marketplace configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_network"
  not r.change.after.audit_logging
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce audit_logging for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo marketplace list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Container build, provenance and runtime consumption
developer_guide.contract: Image digest, signer identity, SBOM format and admission policy
dependencies: A build runner, registry and runtime pull identity
Chosen scan, signing and verification tools
steps: Build and scan the image; record its immutable digest.
Publish required signatures or attestations under an explicit trust policy.
Verify the digest and policy at the point of consumption.
tests: Verify a trusted digest and reject an unexpected signer or tampered artifact.
Run the image with the intended filesystem, user and secret restrictions.
failures: Verification failure: inspect digest, issuer, signer identity and trust roots.
Runtime failure: inspect image architecture, entrypoint and required writable paths.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.
