opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_least_privilege_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-9 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_automated_backups_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-10 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Monitoring"]
      requirement["Civo Monitoring: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0796"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-monitoring", label: "Civo Monitoring", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_pod_security_restricted_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-11 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce applications for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_audit_telemetry_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM (Tier-12 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_network"
  not r.change.after.audit_logging
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce audit_logging for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_tls_enforcement_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-1 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_loadbalancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce tls_enabled for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_private_networking_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-2 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce network_id for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_encryption_at_rest_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-3 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Monitoring"]
      requirement["Civo Monitoring: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0801"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-monitoring", label: "Civo Monitoring", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_firewall_whitelist_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-4 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_firewall"
  not r.change.after.firewall_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce firewall_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_least_privilege_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-5 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_automated_backups_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-6 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_pod_security_restricted_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-7 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce applications for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_audit_telemetry_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM (Tier-8 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_network"
  not r.change.after.audit_logging
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce audit_logging for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Monitoring"]
      requirement["Civo Monitoring: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0806"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-monitoring", label: "Civo Monitoring", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_tls_enforcement_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-9 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_loadbalancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce tls_enabled for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_private_networking_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-10 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce network_id for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_encryption_at_rest_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-11 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_firewall_whitelist_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-12 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_firewall"
  not r.change.after.firewall_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce firewall_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_least_privilege_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-1 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Monitoring"]
      requirement["Civo Monitoring: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0811"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-monitoring", label: "Civo Monitoring", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_automated_backups_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-2 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_pod_security_restricted_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-3 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce applications for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_audit_telemetry_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM (Tier-4 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_network"
  not r.change.after.audit_logging
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce audit_logging for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_tls_enforcement_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-5 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_loadbalancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce tls_enabled for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.

civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_private_networking_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-6 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce network_id for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Monitoring"]
      requirement["Civo Monitoring: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0816"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-monitoring", label: "Civo Monitoring", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_monitoring.civo_monitoring_encryption_at_rest_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Monitoring: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-7 Prometheus & Cluster Metrics)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Monitoring configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo monitoring list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application telemetry and analysis
developer_guide.contract: Trace or request ID, event schema, timestamp, metric labels and retention
dependencies: Application instrumentation or an explicit ingestion connector
A telemetry destination and scoped writer identity
steps: Emit structured events with a stable correlation ID.
Configure ingestion, retention and query permissions.
Create an actionable query or alert and test it with a known event.
tests: Trace one request through application logs and dependency calls.
Confirm an injected failure triggers the intended alert.
failures: Missing telemetry: inspect exporter configuration and ingestion permissions.
High ingestion cost: inspect duplicate exporters and high-cardinality labels.

civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_security.civo_security_tls_enforcement_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Security Guardrails: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-1 Guardrails & Pod Security Standards)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Security Guardrails configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_loadbalancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce tls_enabled for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo security list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_security.civo_security_private_networking_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Security Guardrails: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-2 Guardrails & Pod Security Standards)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Security Guardrails configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce network_id for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo security list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Security Guardrails configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_security.civo_security_encryption_at_rest_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Security Guardrails: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-3 Guardrails & Pod Security Standards)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Security Guardrails configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo security list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Security Guardrails"]
      requirement["Civo Security Guardrails: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0820"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-security", label: "Civo Security Guardrails", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_security.civo_security_firewall_whitelist_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Security Guardrails: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-4 Guardrails & Pod Security Standards)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Security Guardrails configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_firewall"
  not r.change.after.firewall_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce firewall_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo security list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_security.civo_security_least_privilege_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Security Guardrails: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-5 Guardrails & Pod Security Standards)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Security Guardrails configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo security list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

    end

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_security.civo_security_automated_backups_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Security Guardrails: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-6 Guardrails & Pod Security Standards)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Security Guardrails configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo security list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Finding ingestion and bounded response
developer_guide.contract: Finding ID, resource, severity, status and deduplication key
dependencies: Enabled detectors or explicitly connected telemetry sources
A finding destination and a separately authorized response handler
steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.
Route a test finding to the response handler.
Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.
Replay the event and confirm duplicate handling is safe.
failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
Repeated remediation: inspect event deduplication and handler state.

civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Security Guardrails configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile)

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_security.civo_security_pod_security_restricted_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Security Guardrails: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-7 Guardrails & Pod Security Standards)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Security Guardrails configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce applications for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo security list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Security Guardrails"]
      requirement["Civo Security Guardrails: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile)"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0824"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-security", label: "Civo Security Guardrails", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

steps: Enable the supported detectors and connect their sources.

Require idempotency and authorization before any resource mutation.
tests: Deliver a known finding and confirm it reaches the right owner.

failures: Missing finding: check detector availability and source enablement.
