threat_model.attack_vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_private_networking_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-10 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce network_id for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Redis DBaaS"]
      requirement["Civo Redis DBaaS: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0913"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-redis", label: "Civo Redis DBaaS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_encryption_at_rest_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-11 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_firewall_whitelist_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-12 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_firewall"
  not r.change.after.firewall_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce firewall_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_least_privilege_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-1 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Redis DBaaS"]
      requirement["Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0916"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-redis", label: "Civo Redis DBaaS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_automated_backups_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-2 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_pod_security_restricted_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-3 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce applications for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

threat_model.attack_vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_audit_telemetry_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM (Tier-4 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_network"
  not r.change.after.audit_logging
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce audit_logging for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Redis DBaaS"]
      requirement["Civo Redis DBaaS: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0919"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-redis", label: "Civo Redis DBaaS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_tls_enforcement_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-5 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_loadbalancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce tls_enabled for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_private_networking_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-6 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce network_id for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

civo apikey current

checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_encryption_at_rest_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-7 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Redis DBaaS"]
      requirement["Civo Redis DBaaS: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0922"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-redis", label: "Civo Redis DBaaS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_firewall_whitelist_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-8 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_firewall"
  not r.change.after.firewall_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce firewall_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_least_privilege_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-9 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_automated_backups_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-10 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Redis DBaaS"]
      requirement["Civo Redis DBaaS: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0925"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-redis", label: "Civo Redis DBaaS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_pod_security_restricted_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-11 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce applications for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path
Verify resource scope, service support, and the actual policy effect before deployment.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_audit_telemetry_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM (Tier-12 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_network"
  not r.change.after.audit_logging
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce audit_logging for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

threat_model.attack_vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_tls_enforcement_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-1 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_loadbalancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce tls_enabled for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Redis DBaaS"]
      requirement["Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0928"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-redis", label: "Civo Redis DBaaS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_private_networking_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-2 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce network_id for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_encryption_at_rest_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-3 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_firewall_whitelist_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-4 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_firewall"
  not r.change.after.firewall_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce firewall_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_least_privilege_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-5 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_automated_backups_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-6 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets

Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile)

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_pod_security_restricted_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-7 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce applications for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Redis DBaaS"]
      requirement["Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile)"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0934"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-redis", label: "Civo Redis DBaaS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Read back the effective setting and exercise its rejection path"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_audit_telemetry_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Mandate Real-Time Audit Log Forwarding to SIEM (Tier-8 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_network"
  not r.change.after.audit_logging
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce audit_logging for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Generate a known event and verify delivery to the configured destination
Telemetry requires enabled sources, access permissions, retention, and a tested delivery path. A detection or alert does not automatically remediate a resource.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_tls_enforcement_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Encrypted Transport with TLS 1.3 Termination (Tier-9 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_loadbalancer"
  not r.change.after.tls_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce tls_enabled for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test protocol negotiation and certificate trust
Transport encryption, identity validation, and authorization are separate checks. A SecureTransport condition alone does not set a minimum TLS version.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_private_networking_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP (Tier-10 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Information Disclosure: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_instance"
  not r.change.after.network_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce network_id for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Redis DBaaS"]
      requirement["Civo Redis DBaaS: Require Private Network Attachment without Public IP"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0937"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-redis", label: "Civo Redis DBaaS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

aws configure list

checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_encryption_at_rest_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Mandate AES-256 Server-Side Encryption at Rest (Tier-11 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Denial of Service: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_object_store"
  not r.change.after.encryption_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce encryption_enabled for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Verify key identity and permitted encrypt or decrypt operations
Check service support, key location, key policy, and the service identity. Encryption at rest does not prevent an authorized data read.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_firewall_whitelist_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Restrict Ingress to Zero-Trust CIDR Whitelists (Tier-12 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Critical Security Controls v8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4, GDPR Article 32
# Threat Vector: Elevation of Privilege: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_firewall"
  not r.change.after.firewall_id
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce firewall_id for compliance standard CIS Critical Security Controls v8", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test an allowed source and a denied source against the actual endpoint
Identity, network reachability, and application permissions are independent. Private networking and DNS require explicit service-specific configuration.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

threat_model.attack_vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
threat_model.defense_barrier: Civo Firewall CIDR Ingress Whitelist & Enforced Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_least_privilege_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens (Tier-1 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1, ISO/IEC 27001 A.13.1, NIST CSF PR.AC-3, PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 1
# Threat Vector: Spoofing: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_iam_token"
  not r.change.after.permissions
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce permissions for compliance standard SOC 2 Type II CC6.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
deployment_mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph proposal["Civo Cloud: proposed control change"]
      change["Proposed configuration for Civo Redis DBaaS"]
      requirement["Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Role-Based Ephemeral Scoped API Tokens"]
      identity@{ icon: "logos:civo-iam", label: "Civo API key or team permissions", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      change --> requirement
      identity -.->|Required permissions| change
    end
    subgraph validation["Review and pre-deployment validation"]
      check{"Service-specific checks pass?"}
      reject["Revise configuration; no change applied"]
      review["Owner review: CIVO-BP-0940"]
      requirement --> check
      check -->|No or unknown| reject
      check -->|Yes| review
    end
    subgraph target["Civo Cloud: resource administration"]
      resource@{ icon: "logos:civo-redis", label: "Civo Redis DBaaS", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      review -->|Apply through the supported service management API| resource
    end
    subgraph verification["Readback and operational evidence"]
      verify["Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope"]
      evidence@{ icon: "logos:civo-audit", label: "Civo audit events and cluster telemetry", h: 64, pos: "b" }
      outcome{"Observed behavior matches control?"}
      followup["Investigate drift or missing enforcement"]
      accepted["Record resource scope, result, and evidence"]
      resource -->|Read effective configuration| verify
      resource -.->|Separate audit or evidence path| evidence
      verify --> outcome
      outcome -->|No or unknown| followup
      outcome -->|Yes| accepted
      evidence -.->|Correlate with test results| accepted
    end

developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.

civo apikey current
aws configure list

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Test the intended principal and a principal outside the allowed scope
Evaluate effective permissions, inherited grants, explicit denies, and credential lifetime. A policy attachment alone does not establish least privilege.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_automated_backups_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enable Daily Automated Snapshots and Backups (Tier-2 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0, SOC 2 CC6.6, ISO 27001 A.12.6, NIST 800-53 SC-7
# Threat Vector: Tampering: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_volume"
  not r.change.after.backup_enabled
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce backup_enabled for compliance standard CIS Civo Kubernetes Benchmark v1.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

developer_guide.name: Application query and data access
developer_guide.contract: Collection or table, partition key, query shape and consistency model
dependencies: A provisioned data store and scoped application identity
A query or item access pattern and an explicit retry budget
steps: Create tables, containers or datasets with the intended partitioning.
Grant only the required query or item operations.
Handle throttling, pagination and idempotent writes in the application.
tests: Test representative queries and partition distribution.
Exercise throttling, duplicate delivery and access to a disallowed dataset.
failures: Throttling: inspect partition hotspots, request units or quota.
Missing rows: inspect key selection, consistency and query permissions.
developer_guide.diagnostics:
civo apikey current
aws configure list
developer_guide.scope: Reference integration pattern. Provision and configure the named dependencies separately; the companion catalog snippets are not a complete application deployment.

diagram_details.scope: Control deployment and verification workflow. Companion policy and configuration snippets are illustrative; validate their schema, inputs, and resource coverage before applying them.
checks: Perform restore or failover verification with recorded recovery targets
Replication, versioning, retention lock, and backup recovery provide different guarantees. Select supported settings and test recovery before relying on them.
Confirm effective permissions and record both successful and rejected test cases.

opa_policy:
package civo.civo_redis.civo_redis_pod_security_restricted_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Civo Redis DBaaS: Enforce Pod Security Standards (Restricted Profile) (Tier-3 Managed In-Memory Redis Cache)
# Compliance: HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1), SOC 2 CC6.7, NIST SP 800-53 SC-8, PCI DSS Requirement 4
# Threat Vector: Repudiation: Unauthorized exploit targeting unhardened Civo Redis DBaaS configuration
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "civo_kubernetes_cluster"
  not r.change.after.applications
  msg := sprintf("Civo resource %v must enforce applications for compliance standard HIPAA Security Rule 164.312(e)(1)", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource via Civo CLI: civo redis list or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
